# port_user (Resource)

User resource to manage Port users, including roles, teams, and inactivity timeout



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The email address of the user

### Optional

- `inactivity_timeout` (Number) The inactivity timeout in minutes for the user. Must be at least 10 when set. Set to `null` to clear.
- `roles` (Set of String) The roles assigned to the user
- `teams` (Set of String) The teams assigned to the user

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `managed_by_scim` (Boolean) Whether the user is managed by SCIM
- `status` (String) The status of the user
